purpose: Externally test the smallest development-selected astronomical object from the Gauquelin VITALITY minimization in an independent, astrology-naive cohort without allowing MoBa outcomes to influence the predictor or primary analysis.

development_source.warning: Gauquelin data are DEVELOPMENT only and have astrology-related trait-category history.

external_dataset.study: Norwegian Mother, Father and Child Cohort Study (MoBa)

birth_variables.FKLOKKEN: child time of birth, HHMM / ttmm

external_dataset.access_rule: Use only lawfully approved MoBa/MBRN linked data. If exact date/time cannot be released to the analyst, the data custodian may run the frozen derivation code inside the secure environment and release only the derived predictor and frozen low-frequency calendar controls.
external_dataset.eligibility_gate: Before outcome inspection, verify that FDATO and FKLOKKEN can be linked to the 18-month questionnaire either directly in the approved secure analysis environment or via custodian-side derivation. Failure is dataset ineligibility, not replication failure.

primary_predictor.label: 5-15 two-window co-occurrence
primary_predictor.activation_set: All standard 13 Personality plus 13 Design activations used by the repository chart engine; Earth and South Node are the standard derived opposites.
primary_predictor.design_moment: Exact backward 88-degree Personality-Sun to Design-Sun solar-arc root.
primary_predictor.formula: Z=1 iff at least one standard Personality/Design activation has tropical geocentric longitude in [251.375,257.000) AND at least one standard Personality/Design activation has tropical geocentric longitude in [88.250,93.875).
primary_predictor.predicted_direction: Z=1 predicts higher temperament activity / vitality-related behavior.

primary_outcome.instrument: EAS short-form Activity subscale in MoBa Q5 at 18 months

items.text: Your child is always on the go
items.raw_scale: 1 Very typical ... 5 Not at all typical

items.text: Your child is off and running as soon as he/she wakes up in the morning
items.raw_scale: 1 Very typical ... 5 Not at all typical

items.text: Your child prefers quiet, inactive games to more active ones
items.raw_scale: 1 Very typical ... 5 Not at all typical

primary_outcome.score: Arithmetic mean of the three aligned item scores, requiring all three items for the primary complete-case analysis. Range 1-5; higher = more active.
primary_outcome.construct_note: This is a prospective construct-transport test of the development VITALITY/energy signal, not a literal reuse of the Gauquelin archival label.

primary_analysis.estimand: Adjusted mean difference in 18-month EAS Activity score for Z=1 versus Z=0.
primary_analysis.model: Linear regression with family/mother-cluster-robust standard errors. Frozen controls: child sex; birth-year indicators; day-of-year sine/cosine at harmonics k=1 and k=2; local time-of-day sine/cosine at harmonics k=1 and k=2.
primary_analysis.primary_test: Two-sided test of the Z coefficient; report the development-predicted positive direction explicitly. Do not substitute a one-sided test after inspecting the outcome.
primary_analysis.missing_outcome: Primary analysis requires all three EAS Activity items; no imputation.
primary_analysis.multiple_births_and_siblings: Keep eligible children but use family/mother-cluster-robust uncertainty. Report singleton-only and one-child-per-mother analyses as sensitivities.
primary_analysis.timezone_and_dst: Interpret registry birth clock time as Norwegian civil local time using frozen IANA Europe/Oslo rules appropriate to the birth date. For ambiguous autumn DST-fold times, evaluate both UTC instants: classify Z only if invariant, otherwise mark unresolved. Flag impossible spring-gap times.
effect_reporting: N eligible and N complete primary outcome
mean/SD Activity score in Z=1 and Z=0
incremental out-of-sample R-squared over the frozen control model

secondary_analyses: Prorated Activity score when at least two of three items are observed.
Item-level ordinal models for EE417, EE419 and EE423 in their frozen aligned directions.
Later MoBa EAS Activity measurements, if exact same construct is verified before their outcome values are inspected.
Canonical five-channel development candidate: 2-14 OR 5-15 OR 29-46 OR 6-59 OR 3-60.
Negative predictor controls: Gate 5 only; Gate 15 only; Gate 5 OR Gate 15.
Additional perinatal covariates only as labeled robustness models, never chosen by which improves the result.

specificity_controls.rotations: Evaluate the exact frozen 5-15 orientation against a predeclared set of joint rotations only after the primary test; never select a new orientation from MoBa.
specificity_controls.other_eas_subscales: Shyness, Emotionality and Sociability may be reported as phenotype-specificity diagnostics but are not primary negative outcomes because AstroHD may make separate predictions for them.

engine.requirement: Canonical validation calculation must use the repository's verified Swiss Ephemeris path and provenance checks.

exploratory_feasibility_only.sample: 10,000 uniformly sampled birth moments from 1999-01-01 through 2008-12-31
exploratory_feasibility_only.interpretation: Strong expected predictor variation; this estimate is not outcome evidence.

success_interpretation.primary_success: A positive association on the frozen 18-month Activity score under the frozen primary analysis is independent construct-transport evidence for the development-selected 5-15 object.
success_interpretation.primary_failure: A null or opposite association is a failed MoBa replication/transport test and may not be rescued by retuning 5-15 on MoBa.
success_interpretation.eligibility_failure: If linked exact birth date/time cannot be used or derived before outcome access, report MoBa as ineligible; do not inspect outcomes and do not count it as replication failure.
